name: BSP_UnitInstance_ComputeYawRateFromRudder
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. float10 __thiscall(unit, float rudder) RET 4. Maps a rudder command to a yaw rate: rate = 0082ECB0(rudder, forward speed from 0092D730, unit+9DCh turnEfficiency), scaled by 008E6430(5, unit) when 00E0C978 and (*00F88C30)+C4h are both set and left unscaled otherwise. Called from 0092E8C0 at 0092E950 and from 00825F20 at 00826C75. 0082ECB0, the curve itself, was not analysed. docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md
